Hello! Don't worry at all, we are here to help you get started.

Direct Memory Access (DMA) uses a PCIe card installed in your main gaming PC (Target PC) that reads the system memory independently of the CPU and sends it to a secondary PC (Radar/Cheat PC) via a USB connection. Because the software runs entirely on the secondary PC, it remains completely invisible to software-based anti-cheats on your gaming PC, as long as a secure, custom 1:1 emulated firmware is used.

If you are looking to get started, we offer a Full Hardware Bundle for 220 EUR (which includes the Makcu, DMA Card, and Fuser; express shipping is not included). You will also need a firmware matched to the game and anti-cheat you plan to play.

Please let me know which games you play or if you have any questions about the hardware or firmwares, and I'll be happy to guide you!

Elyra SupportBOT 15:01
Since you can buy things separately, you generally need two main components to set up a DMA system:

1. Hardware: You need the physical components. We offer a Full Hardware Bundle for 220 EUR (which includes the Makcu, DMA Card, and Fuser), or you can ask about individual hardware pieces. Additionally, you will need a secondary PC (like a laptop or another computer) to run the radar/software, and appropriate cables.
2. Firmware: The DMA card requires a custom firmware to bypass anti-cheats safely. The firmware you need depends on the game you play:
- Valorant (Vanguard): ELYRA VMD, ELYRA 2, or ELYRA 3.
- Rust, Apex Legends, Fortnite (EAC): ELYRA 1, ELYRA 2, or ELYRA 3.
- R6 Siege, Tarkov (BattlEye) & Call of Duty (Ricochet): Any ELYRA firmware is supported.
- CS2 / General (VAC): Any firmware we sell is sufficient.

You can choose to buy the Full Hardware Bundle and pair it with the specific firmware of your choice. Please let us know which games you plan to play, and a staff member will gladly assist you in putting together the right combination for your setup!
